RequestAccess.title: Request access.
RequestAccess.intro: There is no sign-up button, on purpose. {owner} adds people by hand, a few at a time. This is a request rather than a registration, and nothing here creates an account.
RequestAccess.noscript: The form needs JavaScript. All it does is send {owner} your address.

Form.emailHint: We send a code here to check the address is really yours.
Form.codeHint: Six digits, sent to {email}. It expires in fifteen minutes.
Form.sentBody: Requests are read by hand. If it is a yes, you will get an email.
Form.errNetwork: Something went wrong sending that. Check your connection and try again.
Form.errRate: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
Form.errMail: Mail is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
Form.errServer: Something went wrong on our end. Try again.
Form.errAddress: That address does not look right.
